author: National Geographic
description:
National Geographic 33 changemaker Ewan McGregor is on a mission to bring us beautiful, unfiltered views of the world—from the back of his vintage motorcycle. In Long Way Home, the new installment of his Long Way television series, the Star Wars actor set out on a 7,000-mile transcontinental motorcycle trip with fellow actor Charley Boorman. The duo’s authentic approach to travel content is the ultimate antidote to today’s overly polished vacation posts on social media. Learn more about his philosophy on travel: https://go.natgeo.blink.app/8bff8a

The National Geographic 33—inspired by our 33 founders—is an initiative honoring changemakers who are rising to meet the most critical challenges of our time, making meaningful progress and incredible breakthroughs.
